single.description: Use single-threaded mode for mapping. Default is parallel processing.

force_positive.description: Force every mapped HEX8 Jacobian positive by swapping connectivity. Use when source mesh has unreliable handedness.

flip_x.description: Mirror output along global X axis. Swaps HEX8 connectivity when odd-parity flips would invert Jacobian.

flip_y.description: Mirror output along global Y axis. Can be combined with --flip-x and/or --flip-z.

flip_z.description: Mirror output along global Z axis. Can be combined with --flip-x and/or --flip-y.

flip_input_x.description: Pre-map detail flat mirror along X. Mirrors detail BEFORE mapping so features land on opposite face of bent target. Use for slit/hole face swap.

flip_input_y.description: Pre-map detail flat mirror along Y axis. Can be combined with --flip-input-x and/or --flip-input-z.

flip_input_z.description: Pre-map detail flat mirror along Z axis. Can be combined with --flip-input-x and/or --flip-input-y.

bbox_align.description: Auto-rescale to remove uniform stretch. 'source' rescales detail to bent ijk lengths; 'target' rescales bent to detail XYZ lengths; 'none' disables (default).

bbox_align_max_drift.description: Reject scaling if any axis ratio drifts beyond this percent. Default 2.0%.

target_pid.description: Target specific part IDs for mapping (comma or space separated). Default: all parts. Example: --target-pid '1,2,3' or --target-pids '1 2 3'.

bent_mesh.description: Bent structured reference mesh (LS-DYNA .k file). Must contain HEX8 elements.

flat_mesh.description: Flat unstructured mesh to be mapped (LS-DYNA .k file). CAD-derived with material/section definitions.

output.description: Output file path for mapped mesh (LS-DYNA .k). Contains remapped geometry with all source material/part definitions.

extra_inputs.description: 옵션이 가리키는 보조 파일의 절대경로. 잡 work/ 폴더로 같이 올라가므로 옵션 값에는 파일 이름만 쓰면 된다. 허용 범위: /data/single/<사용자>/, /shared/uploads/users/<사용자>/, /data/scenario/.

slurm.description: 잡 자원(선택). 생략하면 도구 종류별 기본(전처리 2 CPU·8G, 후처리 4 CPU·16G, 24시간)을 클러스터에서 가장 큰 노드에 맞춰 줄여 쓴다.

dry_run.description: true 면 제출하지 않고 생성될 입력 파일·명령만 돌려준다(PAT 없이도 된다). 먼저 이걸로 확인할 것.

wait_sec.description: 제출 후 이 시간(초) 안에 끝나면 결과(rc·로그 꼬리·작은 산출물)를 함께 돌려준다. 0 = job_id 만.

job_name.description: 잡 이름(결과 폴더 이름이 된다). 생략하면 stmc_<도구이름>.
